data.title: Palace Residences Hillside
data.about:
Elevate your lifestyle at Emaar Palace Residences, the first 5-star branded residence in Dubai Hills Estate. Enjoy signature luxury inspired by Palace hotels and resorts, complete with direct access to Dubai Hills Park and Dubai Hills Mall.

Palace Residences Hillside at Dubai Hills Estate combines heritage, luxury, and modern design to offer a distinctive living experience. Surrounded by lush greenery, this sophisticated development boasts contemporary elegance with its sleek architecture and carefully chosen natural materials.

At The Palace Residences by Emaar, residents are treated to panoramic park views and enjoy seamless connectivity to Downtown Dubai, while nearby Dubai Hills Mall provides ultimate convenience. Indulge in the pools, stay fit at the gym, or relax in communal spaces designed for serene living. Experience The Palace Residences for sale, where luxury and convenience are at your fingertips.

characteristics_module.title: First Ever Branded Palace Residences in Dubai Hills Estate
characteristics_module.heading: UNIQUE SELLING POINTS
characteristics_module.description:
• Prestigious Development: Emaar Palace Residences Hillside, created by Emaar Properties, represents a highly sought-after real estate opportunity for luxury living.
  • Prime Location: Palace Residences Hillside at Dubai Hills Estate is strategically positioned between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina, offering optimal access to the city's top districts and attractions.
  • Comprehensive Amenities: The Palace Residences by Emaar includes state-of-the-art fitness centers, swimming pools, and dedicated areas for relaxation and social activities.
  • Enhanced Lifestyle: The Palace Residences Dubai Hills Estate offers easy access to parks, jogging tracks, and an 18-hole championship golf course, as well as proximity to Dubai Hills Mall, featuring over 650 shopping and dining options.
  • Family-Oriented Community: Emaar Palace Residences offers schools, nurseries, healthcare facilities, and supermarkets, ensuring a complete living environment for families and individuals.
  • Seamless Connectivity: Proposed metro lines and key road networks facilitate access across the city. The community is also conveniently located near Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport.
  • High Investment Potential: The Palace Residences for sale promise strong ROI, high rental yields, and increasing demand due to its versatile range of property types and price.

location_tile.heading: LOCATION
location_tile.description:
Located in the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate, Palace Residences Hillside by Emaar Properties boasts a prime location in the heart of Dubai. This vibrant 2,700-acre community overlooks a stunning 18-hole championship golf course, offering residents breathtaking views and ample recreational opportunities. Its strategic positioning provides seamless connectivity, with Downtown Dubai only minutes away and major landmarks like Dubai Hills Mall, DHE Corporate Park, King's Hospital, and GEMS Schools easily accessible. Discover the exceptional lifestyle of Palace Residences at Dubai Hills Estate.
